UD-036.notes: Cool stone wall on both faces; bounded charred timber grip and worn iron basket. Yellow flame roots, orange lobes and red tips, without painting surrounding bricks.

UD-037.notes: Grey arch and paving; measured vertical grip, iron cup and stakes. Flame is isolated against the corresponding extinguished model, including the low roots inside the cup.

UD-038.notes: Grey arch, worn iron cup and vertical charred grip; dark burnt stub and lighter dusty ash inside the cup, without flame colouring on the wall.

UD-039.notes: Worn iron cage, hoops and rivets, including the low base ring. The measured coal pile is nonmetallic charcoal with pale ash dust; surrounding rubble and paving stay stone.
